Thanks for the work — genuinely. It deserves a straight answer rather than
silence on an open tab.

**Pull requests are not merged in this repository.** It is a solo repository
where changes land by direct push with CI enforced, and that policy was decided
before this change existed. [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) has the
reason.

Please don't bin the work:

- **Open an issue** — bug reports, design disagreements and questions all belong
  there.
- **Put the change in the issue.** A diff, a patch, a branch on your fork, or
  just a clear description. If it is right it gets applied and pushed, and the
  commit message credits you by name and links the issue.
